top_creatures.label: Plated insect swarm
top_creatures.why: Swarm numbers are a readability test at 375 wide. Judged from name family only; no art in box, silhouette not judged.
top_creatures.keep: many of one shape, shared sound
top_creatures.change: fewer, heavier shells; one shared signature sound

top_creatures.label: Mineral construct
top_creatures.change: glowing exposed core as the weak point

top_creatures.label: Undead drifter
top_creatures.why: Pale, floating, low threat to read.
top_creatures.change: fog trail that marks where it has been, to aid threat reading

top_creatures.label: Dragonkin
top_creatures.why: Largest shadow class pairs with a big body.
top_creatures.change: one wing; tail sweep as signature move

top_creatures.label: Slime or blob
top_creatures.why: Squash-and-bounce is the simplest idle vocabulary.
top_creatures.change: hit reaction splits into two small blobs

top_creatures.label: Aquatic ambusher
top_creatures.change: rises from a water tile as an ambush

top_creatures.label: Beast pack
top_creatures.change: one shared aggro list for the pack, engine-owned

classes.group: later classes and pet or transform ids

weapon_families.types: one-hand and two-hand forms of each
handgun, rifle, gatling, shotgun, grenade launcher
knuckle, instrument, whip, book, katar, shuriken, two-hand rod
6 distinct files: sword, axe, mace, rod, spear, arrow; mace used by 18 rows including the no-weapon fallback

gear_tiers.note: Item rows have no rarity field (fields: display names, resource names, description arrays, slotCount, ClassNum). Description colour markup is text emphasis, not a tier system.

zones.note: pale warm sky with dark red cloud tint
dark purple sky with pink cloud tint
112 ground-unit rows: wall types (safety, fire, ice), slow field, mine, pillar, healing area

looks.label: Vertex-wave water with looping caustic strip
looks.technique: surface height is a sine of position plus a time offset; texture frame picked over 32 frames

looks.label: Pre-aged cloud pool
looks.technique: 150 sprites, random life up to 8000 ms, born 2000 ms in the past

looks.label: Stepped lock-on ring
looks.technique: 20 brightness steps; spin of tick over 4 degrees; one uniform tints two channels

looks.label: Damage numbers
looks.technique: 1500 ms lifetime; alpha 1 minus life fraction; size scaled by a factor; colour chosen by hit-type bits

looks.label: Keyed effects with random variants
looks.technique: 323 keyed entries; %d in a file name replaced by a random range; sound and attached-entity flag per entry

looks.label: Shadow by monster id
looks.technique: scale per id; zero means no shadow

looks.label: Hit sound per weapon type
looks.technique: one hit file per weapon family; mace as fallback

originals.name: Caustic shallows
originals.idea: Shallow-water floor with a vertex wave and a 32-frame caustic loop; ripples radiate from fight impacts.
originals.keep: cheap vertex wave; looping caustic strip
originals.change: ripples come from hits; our palette; no clouds

originals.name: Rune halo
originals.idea: Target ring with discrete steps (12 or 20), two colours, and a facing spoke.
originals.keep: discrete steps for readability; slow spin
originals.change: segmented runes; spin follows the fighter's stance rather than a fixed rate

originals.name: Ember numbers
originals.idea: Hit numbers that punch in, arc up and fade.
originals.keep: colour by hit class; alpha by life
originals.change: punch scale on spawn; arc path; own glyphs

originals.name: Zone sky card
originals.idea: One keyed zone table with gradient and horizon band fields; boss rooms get a dim entry.
originals.change: gradient and horizon as data fields

originals.name: Ground hazard set
originals.idea: Four ground hazards as data rows: wall, slow field, mine, healing area; each with a warning ring before it is live.

originals.name: Hit families
originals.idea: Six hit-sound families; dual-weapon characters layer both; a crit stinger sits on top.
originals.change: explicit fallback family with a log line when a weapon has no family
